scope: public specification metadata only; zero provider data requests

sources.paraphrase: Rows omit minutes without executions; minute timestamps denote interval start, terminal auctions are separate, PM opening auction cannot be isolated from its minute. Prices are unadjusted; error corrections may overwrite values.
Dated snapshots describe listed codes. Listing/delisting dates, merger and code succession histories are not supplied; snapshot continuity alone does not certify identity.

Raw prices are not retroactively corporate-action adjusted. Adjusted prices are revised backwards; past delivered adjusted versions cannot be requested. ExRT identifies split/reverse/rights effective dates, not announcement availability. Null bars cannot distinguish halt from no executions.
Daily and minute prices are scheduled around 16:30; master around 17:30 and next-business-day 08:00. Times are approximate and unguaranteed, and cannot certify a historical version.
No ISIN/FIGI, suspension feed, full corporate-action dataset, past actual update-time record, version number or ETag is provided. These limitations prevent recovery from ordinary re-download alone.
Error corrections exist, including adjusted rights-issue prices revised on 2026-06-29. A current correction page is not an exhaustive historical version receipt.
